UPDATE leave_requests SET start_date=?,days=?,handover_note=?,leave_type_id=?,end_date=?,start_segment=?,end_segment=?,policy_version_id=?,calculated_units=?,calculation_snapshot=?::jsonb,
    evidence_policy_snapshot=?::jsonb,evidence_due_at=?,submitted_at=CASE WHEN ?='pending_approval' THEN ? ELSE submitted_at END,
    state=?,version=?,prepared_by=?,decided_by=NULL,decision_note=NULL,last_command_id=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?
leave_ss_stmt_9:
INSERT INTO leave_policy_rules(
      policy_version_id,leave_type_id,grant_kind,grant_units,accrual_units,accrual_period,carryover_limit,employee_eligible,contractor_eligible,
      evidence_min_units,evidence_purpose,evidence_min_count,evidence_due_stage,evidence_grace_days,evidence_note,evidence_privacy
    ) SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'requester_approvers_hr' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leave_types WHERE id=? AND company_id=?)
leave_ss_stmt_10: INSERT INTO leave_holidays(id,calendar_id,holiday_date,name) SELECT ?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM leave_holiday_calendars WHERE id=? AND company_id=?)
leave_ss_stmt_11: UPDATE leave_policy_assignments SET effective_to=? WHERE id=?
leave_ss_stmt_12: INSERT INTO leave_policy_assignments(id,company_id,engagement_id,policy_version_id,holiday_calendar_id,effective_from,effective_to,created_by,created_at) SELECT ?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hr_engagements WHERE id=? AND company_id=?)
leave_ss_stmt_13: UPDATE leave_policy_assignments SET effective_to=?,version=version+1 WHERE id=? AND company_id=?
leave_ss_stmt_14: INSERT INTO leave_balance_entries(id,company_id,engagement_id,leave_type_id,kind,units,effective_date,command_key,note,created_by,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,'adjustment',?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(company_id,command_key,kind,leave_type_id) DO NOTHING
